package main

import sdk "example.com/godj-openapi-client/inventoryapi"

const evolved = true

func setNewField(value *sdk.AssetInput) {
	value.Priority = sdk.NewOptAssetInputPriority(sdk.AssetInputPriority(9))
}
func defaultProjection(value *sdk.Asset) bool  { return value.Priority == 5 }
func explicitProjection(value *sdk.Asset) bool { return value.Priority == 9 }
func requestFields() []string                  { return []string{"Code", "Enabled", "Note", "Priority"} }
func responseFields() []string                 { return []string{"Code", "Enabled", "ID", "Priority"} }
func requestPolicy() bool {
	invalid := sdk.AssetInput{Code: "invalid", Priority: sdk.NewOptAssetInputPriority(sdk.AssetInputPriority(2))}
	return invalid.Validate() != nil
}
